name: Banjong Pisanthanakun
bio: Banjong Pisanthanakun (Thai: บรรจง ปิสัญธนะกูล) is Thai filmmaker and screenwriter. With Parkpoom Wongpoom, he co-directed and co-wrote the hit 2004 Thai horror film, Shutter, and the 2007 horror film, Alone.

credits.title: GFF
credits.overview: The comedy drama dives into the chaotic, fluid, and funny side of love, focusing on a long-term gay couple who face an unexpected identity crisis.

credits.title: Inherit
credits.overview: Follows a wealthy family whose polished exterior begins to crack when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their bloodline.

credits.title: God Skin
credits.overview: Win, takes a lethal gamble to fund his mother's medical treatment when Itt, an old friend, lures him into the Arena. In this brutal underground circuit, fighters are marked with "God Skin" tattoos to gain a ruthless edge.

credits.title: Warkop DKI: ViRaLiN dOoOoNg..!!
credits.overview: Three best friends, Dono, Kasino, and Indro, want to get quickly rich by becoming content creators. After numerous failed attempts, they try making a horror-drama video in a remote village. However, their fake plan turns into reality when they are actually haunted by vengeful spirits. credits.title: The Red Envelope
credits.overview: After a supernatural marriage binds them for life, thief-turned-informant Menn and his ghost husband Titi set out to solve the mystery of Titi's death.

credits.title: Not Friends
credits.overview: A group of high school students who dream of making films set out to make a short film based on the life of a classmate. However, they discover a secret that could change their vision of filmmaking forever.

credits.title: You & Me & Me
credits.overview: A nostalgic, coming-of-age story of identical twin sisters who share every aspect of their lives with one another, until one day a boy walks into their lives and puts their strong bond to the test.

credits.title: The Medium
credits.overview: A shaman's family learn that their goddess is supposedly controlling one of them. However, their lives take a frightening turn when they realise the goddess has nothing to do with the possession.

credits.title: Heartbeat
credits.overview: An ordinary man who can hear other people's heartbeat but his own heartbeat could not be heard, even using stethoscope until one day he met a girl who works together with him in a department store.

credits.title: One Day
credits.overview: A woman suffers from a rare form of temporary amnesia, lasting for a day. Her shy colleague, who is secretly in love with her, tells her that they are a couple in order to experience being with her for just one day.

credits.title: Heart Attack
credits.overview: A hard-worker freelancer who falls in love with a doctor. While his life is getting worse every second. He must find the way to release his life to the beyond of everything.

credits.title: The Master
credits.overview: A Thai documentary about 'Van VDO' the VHS shop in 1990s. The shop established the independent cinema scene for Thai audience by selling VHS of American, European, and Asian indie films. However, all of them are pirate and illegal.

credits.title: Pee Mak
credits.overview: Mak's friends just want to protect him, but his wife Nak won't let a small thing like her own death get in the way of true love.

credits.title: The ABCs of Death
credits.overview: An ambitious anthology film featuring segments directed by over two dozen of the world's leading talents in contemporary genre film. credits.title: Hello Stranger
credits.overview: Two strangers meet in South Korea, each on a vacation.  When he misses his tour bus, he asks a woman if he can hang out with her for a few days. They have fun together, but never tell each other their names.  So when the trip is over they don't know how to contact each other.

credits.title: Phobia 2
credits.overview: An anthology of five macabre short stories about hungry ghosts, comatose brain dead, a group of bright-eyed actors, an unscrupulous car salesman, and careless backpack tourists.

credits.title: 4bia
credits.overview: Four directors create short films based on unique fears involving a lonely woman, a princess's corpse, a haunted camping trip and a cursed manuscript.

credits.title: Alone
credits.overview: When Pim and Ploy, twins conjoined at the stomach, are separated, the operation leaves Pim the surviving sister, haunted by Ploy's vengeful ghost.

credits.title: Shutter
credits.overview: When Jane and Tun run over a girl in a car accident, they speed away immediately from the crime scene. However, Tun, a photographer, soon discovers strange shadows in his photos, which unsettles them.

credits.title: Colorblind
credits.overview: Tum is colorblind. One day he meets a girl who change his sight.
